description.value: Totem Design House is an Indigenous-owned design studio and retail shop on Vancouver Island offering Northwest Coast fine art prints, handcrafted jewelry, apparel, home decor, and wellness products — all artist-designed and crafted in-house. The business supports the Copper Legacy Indigenous Empowerment Society with every purchase, and also offers candle-making classes for groups. A touring cyclist would find it a distinctive cultural stop for authentic Indigenous art and gifts.
